import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
di,do=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def solid_lines(g, axis):
    n = len(g) if axis==0 else len(g[0])
    lines=[]
    for k in range(n):
        line = g[k] if axis==0 else [r[k] for r in g]
        lines.append(len(set(line))==1 and line[0]!=0)
    return lines
def transform(g):
    sr=solid_lines(g,0); sc=solid_lines(g,1)
    def pick(solid):
        idx=[]; i=0; n=len(solid)
        while i<n:
            if solid[i]: idx.append(i); i+=1
            else:
                j=i
                while j<n and not solid[j]: j+=1
                idx.append(i); i=j
        return idx
    ri=pick(sr); ci=pick(sc)
    return [[g[i][j] for j in ci] for i in ri]
out=transform(di)
print(out==do, out)
